messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearpath.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial signup — looking to evaluate latency/cost for ClearPath feature

Hi team,

I just signed up for the Redwood trial (ClearPath AI account) and wanted to flag a short use case so we can get the right demo. We’re building a streaming summarization feature and need predictable sub-200ms tail latency for 1k token requests, plus cheaper batch throughput for nightly embedding jobs.

Would love a brief walkthrough of:
- recommended models/quantization for this workload
- how to set up prefix/KV caching for session-y traffic
- expected cost tradeoffs (tokens vs instance size)

If possible, can someone share a calendar link for a 30–50 minute technical walkthrough this week? I’m in PST and available most afternoons.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Head of Product
ClearPath AI
alex.ramos@clearpath.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the context; welcome!

I’m looping in Karthik from SDR/solutions to get you scheduled quickly. In the meantime, here are two immediate resources to help you prepare:

1) Redwood quickstart guide (attached): high-level steps for a 30-minute POC and model recommendations.
2) Fast scheduling link: https://app.redwood.ai/schedule/GRACE-50min — pick a slot that fits and the invite will include a short prep doc.

If you prefer, Karthik will propose a couple of PST slots below. We typically run a 50-minute technical walkthrough (50 min recommended if you want a quick live perf demo + Q&A).

Attachments: redwood_quickstart-guide.pdf, demo-ics.ics

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
